title: Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)

entities.name: Event C2
entities.description: The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold. This event triggers measurement reporting when the channel busy ratio falls below the configured threshold.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs NR sidelink measurements and reports events based on channel busy ratio conditions.

entities.name: NR sidelink channel busy ratio
entities.description: Measurement of channel utilization in NR sidelink communications. When this ratio falls below a configured threshold, Event C2 is triggered.

entities.name: Threshold
entities.description: Configured threshold value for the channel busy ratio. Event C2 occurs when the measured ratio goes below this threshold.

relations.description: UE triggers Event C2 when the channel busy ratio measurement condition is met
Event C2 is guarded by the condition that the NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below threshold
Event C2 is guarded by the threshold condition for channel busy ratio
